items.title: Contract No. 35 Traffic Signal Upgrades – Contract Award
items.text: Contract No. 35 Traffic Signal Upgrades – Contract Award Staff Recommendation: Award Construction Contract No. 35 Traffic Signal Upgrades, in the amount of $7,200,000 with a contingency of $720,000 for a term of 578 consecutive calendar days, with a contingency of 58 consecutive calendar days to Bay Area Lightworks, Inc, to perform traffic signal improvements at various locations within the City and County of San Francisco. On March 4, 2021, the Planning Department determined the project to be exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (“CEQA”) as a Class 1 categorical exemption under CEQA Guidelines Section 15301. Approval of the contract would constitute the Approval Action for the project under San Francisco Administrative Code Chapter 31.
items.parent: Consent Calendar of Routine Matters Regular Agenda Items for Consideration

items.title: As-Needed LEED and Sustainability Services 2026 – AECOM - Contract Award
items.text: As-Needed LEED and Sustainability Services 2026 – AECOM - Contract Award Staff Recommendation: Award Professional Services Contract, As-Needed LEED and Sustainability Services 2026 in the amount of $2,600,000 for 1,825 calendar days to AECOM Technical Services, Inc. for LEED and sustainability services, and approve a $1,300,000 contingency to increase the total contract not-to-exceed amount. Also authorize the Director of Public Works to approve future contract modifications, increasing the total not-to-exceed amount to $3,900,000.
